description: BuildsProvisionDatabaseStack::pinMysqlSeries() downloads repo.mysql.com/RPM-GPG-KEY-mysql-2023, which apt now rejects as expired (EXPKEYSIG B7B3B788A8D3785C), so every MySQL 8.4 pin silently falls back to the distro 8.0 package. MySQL publishes RPM-GPG-KEY-mysql-2025, but swapping the URL alone just reschedules the same failure. Fetch to a temporary keyring, verify the expected fingerprint AND that the signing key is not expired, then install atomically before writing the source file; remove stale source and key files on every failure path. Tests: expired key, wrong fingerprint, fetch failure, unsupported suite, successful 8.4 candidate.
title: Replace the expired MySQL signing key source in pinMysqlSeries
